$comment: connection-registry (ADR-037 register fragment). Adds the app_connection schema (hydra umbrella D11: stackiq already owns the global slug `connection`): one row per outside connection an app declares in its lib/Settings/connections.json. Rows are written by ConnectionRegistryService (sync, resolver, reports, health job, link-a-source), never by hand, which is why the overview page hides the built-in create and edit actions. Access is admin-only for every verb, following 99-source-lockdown.json: a row links a source uuid, and the page is an admin page in every app that adopts it. Contract: hydra openspec/changes/connection-registry/design.md, sections D3, D6 and D12. Version 1.1.0 adds the limited status. Version 1.2.0 adds refreshedAt: a refresh retires older reports and probes. Version 1.3.0 adds the disabled status: an admin switched the connection off.

app_connection.title: App connection
app_connection.summary: An outside connection an app declares, with its current status
app_connection.description: One row per entry in an app's connections.json. The status says whether the connection is configured, works in part, is simulated, switched off, unavailable, failing or not checked yet.

app.title: App
app.description: The app that declares this connection.

key.title: Key
key.description: The connection key from the declaration file.

settingsUrl.title: Settings
settingsUrl.description: Where an admin configures this connection.

declaration.title: Declaration
declaration.description: The entry as the app declared it.

declaredVersion.title: Declared version
declaredVersion.description: The app version the declaration was read at.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the connection works, works in part or not at all, as integriq last worked it out.

statusMessage.title: Status message
statusMessage.description: Why the connection has this status.

checkedAt.title: Last checked
checkedAt.description: When the fact behind the status was observed.

source.title: Source
source.description: The integriq source this connection is checked against.

lastProbe.title: Last probe
lastProbe.description: The last test of the linked source: status, message and time.

lastReport.title: Last report
lastReport.description: The last status the app reported: status, message and time. A report of simulated stands against any probe.

refreshedAt.title: Last refresh
refreshedAt.description: When the app last asked for a fresh status after a settings save. Older reports and probes no longer count.
